reason: Middle of the cheapest new-customer offers in Hamburg in October 2026, which comparison sites list at about 27 to 35 ct/kWh. The price includes energy, grid fee, levies and VAT. One value covers the whole period, because fixed contracts usually guarantee the price for 12 to 24 months.
value_limit: Prices are from October 2026 only. In early 2025 the grid fee was higher, so a contract signed then probably cost more. This favours the fixed tariff slightly. Comparison sites differ by several ct/kWh.

reason: Dynamic tariffs in Germany add between 0 and 2.5 ct/kWh to the day-ahead price. 2.0 ct/kWh is in the upper half, so the result does not depend on the cheapest offer. Grid fee, levies and taxes come on top from the other seeds.
